data.title: Greetings & Conversation — Starter · Lesson 7
data.subject: greetings
data.lyrics:
(Hey there, chef!)

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
In the kitchen, let's cook… En la cocina, vamos a cocinar
Chopping and learning, one, two, three… Cortando y aprendiendo, uno, dos, tres
Let's make something great today.

[Verse]
Good morning… Buenos días
The sun is up, and so are we.
How's it going?… ¿Qué tal?
We're making dinner, just you and me.
Excuse me… Disculpa
Pass the salt, if you please.
Take care… Cuídate
While you stir, don't burn your peas.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
In the kitchen, let's cook… En la cocina, vamos a cocinar
Chopping and learning, one, two, three… Cortando y aprendiendo, uno, dos, tres
Let's make something great today.

[Verse]
Good day… Buen día
The aroma's filling up the air.
Nice to meet you… Encantado
Cooking with you, it's only fair.
What's your name?… ¿Cómo te llamas?
I'm Chef, and I'm here to stay.
See you soon… Hasta pronto
After dinner, we'll find a way.

[Bridge]
Thank you… Gracias
